table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	SalePerson=SM.Name,
	SaleDate=S.Date,
	SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode,
	Customer = A.Name,
	SubArea = SA.Name,
	Milage = SA.Distance,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Amount = SUM(SSH.Qty * SSH.SalePrice * (1 - S.DiscPerc * 0.01))
FROM
	SaleLedger S,
	Customer C,
	Accounts A,
	SubArea SA,
	SalesMan SM,
	SaleSetsHeader SSH,
	Item I
WHERE
	S.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate AND
	S.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	C.SubAreaCode = SA.SubAreaCode AND
	C.SalesManCode = SM.SalesManCode AND
	SM.SalesManCode IN (:ai_SalePersonCode) AND
	S.SaleInvCode = SSH.SaleInvCode AND
	SSH.SetICode=I.ICode
GROUP BY
	SM.Name,
	S.Date,
	S.SaleInvCode,
	A.Name,
	SA.Name,
	SA.Distance,
	I.Name
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	SalePerson=SM.Name,
	SaleDate=S.Date,
	SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode,
	Customer = A.Name,
	SubArea = SA.Name,
	Milage = SA.Distance,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Amount = SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - S.DiscPerc * 0.01))
FROM
	SaleLedger S,
	SaleDetail D,
	Customer C,
	Accounts A,
	SubArea SA,
	SalesMan SM,
	Item I
WHERE
	S.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate AND
	S.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	C.SubAreaCode = SA.SubAreaCode AND
	C.SalesManCode = SM.SalesManCode AND
	SM.SalesManCode IN (:ai_SalePersonCode) AND
	S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
	D.ICode=I.ICode AND
	D.RowGroup NOT IN 
		(SELECT RowGroup 
		FROM salesetsheader ssh, salesetsdetail ssd
		Where ssh.saleinvcode = D.SaleInvCode AND
			ssh.setcode = ssd.setcode AND
			ssd.RowGroup = D.RowGroup)
GROUP BY
	SM.Name,
	S.Date,
	S.SaleInvCode,
	A.Name,
	SA.Name,
	SA.Distance,
	I.Name
table.sort: saleperson A, saledate A, saleinvcode A, itemname A
